# Vortex IQ

> Vortex IQ is the AI Operating System for e-commerce. It detects what is broken, explains why, and fixes it safely across every platform a merchant runs. A continuous loop, detect, diagnose, act, safe-deploy, learn, turns raw store signals into resolved work: monitoring KPIs, diagnosing issues, optimising SEO and GEO, automating marketing, and safely staging changes, all from one command centre. Every change is approval-gated with one-click rollback. For enterprises and platforms, Vortex IQ offers grey-label agentic infrastructure to build, deploy and manage bespoke AI agent ecosystems at scale.

## What Vortex IQ does (key capabilities)

1. Real-time monitoring and alerting: the Nerve Centre tracks KPIs across the store, payments, ads and infrastructure, surfacing anomalies with their revenue impact before revenue is lost.
2. AI diagnostics and recommendations: Vortex Mind analyses commerce signals, benchmarks competitors and generates ranked, actionable fix plans.
3. Conversational AI: Ask Viq lets you query your entire stack in plain English and apply safe fixes, with every answer cited to the data and stored in Vortex Memory.
4. Agentic actions and workflows: AI-generated, AI-ranked findings flow onto a Kanban board with assignees, due dates and automation rules, syncing to Jira, Asana and Linear. The platform defines the work and tracks it to done.
5. Agents that act inside the store: Vortex Agents create products and landing pages, issue discount codes, run campaigns and execute operational actions through platform APIs, every change approval-gated.
6. Safe staging, backup and rollback: StagingPro provides production-parity staging and RollbackPro gives one-click rollback for BigCommerce, Shopify and Adobe Commerce, so autonomy is safe to run on live revenue.
7. The unified commerce graph and Vortex Memory: every connector, fix, deploy and decision is written into one live graph across 200+ integrations and 6,000+ KPIs, compounding with every store, report and question.
8. AI Enablement for enterprises and platforms: grey-label infrastructure so platforms can build and scale their own agent ecosystems, including custom MCPs.

## The six pillars (the closed loop)

- [Nerve Centre](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/nerve-centre): real-time detection, KPI tracking and automated alerts. Detect.
- [Vortex Mind](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/vortex-mind): diagnostic and strategy engine that analyses signals, spots bottlenecks and benchmarks competitors. Diagnose.
- [Ask Viq](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/ask-viq): conversational agent spanning all connected systems, cited to the graph. Converse.
- [Vortex Agents](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/vortex-agents): agents that execute changes safely inside the store, approval-gated, with AI-ranked findings tracked as work to done. Act.
- [Vortex Apps](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/vortex-apps): safe deployment infrastructure, StagingPro and RollbackPro, for Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce. Safe-deploy.
- [Vortex Memory](https://www.vortexiq.ai/ai-os-platform/vortex-memory): the compounding data layer and unified commerce graph that every pillar reads from and writes to. Learn.

## Solutions by audience

- [For Merchants and Brands](https://www.vortexiq.ai/solutions/for-merchants-brands): end-to-end AI operations for D2C brands and retailers.
- [For Agencies](https://www.vortexiq.ai/solutions/for-agencies): multi-store management, safe deployments and client reporting.
- [For Tech Partners](https://www.vortexiq.ai/solutions/for-tech-partners): embed AI agents into your own platform or SaaS product.
- [Enterprise](https://www.vortexiq.ai/solutions/enterprise): cross-channel findings, multi-storefront and dedicated support.

## Platforms supported

BigCommerce, Shopify, Adobe Commerce (Magento) and WooCommerce.

## Proof and trust

- 1,400% organic traffic growth (Google Analytics) after the SEO and GEO rollout.
- Across 60+ store audits: 749 issues surfaced, 55% resolved automatically, approval-gated and reversible.
- BigCommerce AI-Pilots partner (Elite).
- ISO 27001 certified. SOC 2 in progress. Data processed in the United Kingdom.
